mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT pp.no, pp.user_nickname AS userNickname, pp.title, pp.description, pp.created_at AS createdAt, pp.updated_at AS updatedAt, pp.thumbnail, pp.user_no AS userNo, pp.fork_count AS forkCount, pp.liked_count AS likedCount, pp.view_count AS viewCount, pp.start_day AS startDay, pp.end_day AS endDay, pp.total_member AS totalMember FROM plan_post pp WHERE pp.no IN ( SELECT DISTINCT pp2.no FROM plan_post pp2 LEFT JOIN plan_post_tag ppt2 ON pp2.no = ppt2.plan_post_no LEFT JOIN plan_attraction_detail pad2 ON pp2.no = pad2.plan_post_no LEFT JOIN attractions a2 ON pad2.attraction_no = a2.no WHERE ( pp2.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pp2.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pp2.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ppt2.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pad2.attraction_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a2.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC
SELECT no, plan_post_no, name FROM plan_post_tag WHERE plan_post_no = #{postNo}

SELECT DISTINCT pp.no AS pp_no, pp.user_nickname AS userNickname, pp.title, pp.description, pp.created_at AS createdAt, pp.updated_at AS updatedAt, pp.user_no AS userNo, pp.fork_count AS forkCount, pp.view_count AS viewCount, pp.liked_count AS likedCount, pp.thumbnail, pp.start_day AS startDay, pp.end_day AS endDay, pp.total_member AS totalMember,
ppt.no AS tag_no, ppt.plan_post_no AS tag_plan_post_no, ppt.name AS tag_name
FROM plan_post pp LEFT JOIN plan_post_tag ppt ON pp.no = ppt.plan_post_no LEFT JOIN plan_attraction_detail pad ON pp.no = pad.plan_post_no LEFT JOIN attractions a ON pad.attraction_no = a.no
WHERE ( pp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pp.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pp.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ppt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pad.attraction_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC

SELECT no, user_nickname, title, description, created_at, updated_at, user_no, fork_count, view_count, liked_count, thumbnail, start_day, end_day, total_member, tags, attraction_titles, addresses FROM plan_post_cache WHERE ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR attraction_titles LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR addresses LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT no, user_nickname, title, description, created_at, updated_at, user_no, fork_count, view_count, liked_count, thumbnail, start_day, end_day, total_member, tags, attraction_titles, addresses, search_all FROM plan_post_cache_indexed WHERE ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR attraction_titles LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR addresses LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT no, user_nickname, title, description, created_at, updated_at, user_no, fork_count, view_count, liked_count, thumbnail, start_day, end_day, total_member, tags, attraction_titles, addresses, search_all FROM plan_post_cache_indexed WHERE search_all LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT no, user_nickname, title, description, created_at, updated_at, user_no, fork_count, view_count, liked_count, thumbnail, start_day, end_day, total_member, tags, attraction_titles, addresses, search_all, MATCH(search_all) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) as relevance_score FROM plan_post_cache_fulltext WHERE MATCH(search_all) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY relevance_score DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT no, user_nickname, title, description, created_at, updated_at, user_no, fork_count, view_count, liked_count, thumbnail, start_day, end_day, total_member, tags, attraction_titles, addresses, search_all, 1.0 as relevance_score FROM plan_post_cache_fulltext WHERE MATCH(search_all) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT no, user_nickname, title, description, created_at, updated_at, user_no, fork_count, view_count, liked_count, thumbnail, start_day, end_day, total_member, tags, attraction_titles, addresses, search_all, MATCH(search_all) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) as relevance_score FROM plan_post_cache_fulltext WHERE MATCH(search_all) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) HAVING relevance_score > 0 ORDER BY relevance_score DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 20
